title: Lesson 14 · Do you speak English?
titleZh: 第14课 你会讲英语吗？

examples.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
examples.zh: 去年我有过一次有趣的经历。

examples.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
examples.zh: 去年我有过一次有趣的经历。

examples.en: A young man waved to me.
He asked me for a lift.

examples.zh: 他也同样用法语回答我。

examples.en: He replied in the same language.
examples.zh: 他也用同样的语言回答。

examples.zh: 旅途中我们谁也没讲话。

sentences.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我有过一次有趣的经历。

sentences.en: On the way, a young man waved to me.
sentences.zh: 途中，一个青年人向我招手。

sentences.en: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
sentences.zh: 我把车停下，他向我提出要求搭车。

article.en: I had an amusing experience last year.
article.zh: 去年我有过一次有趣的经历。

article.en: After I had left a small village in the south of France, I drove on to the next town.
article.zh: 在离开法国南部的一个小村庄后，我继续驶往下一个城镇。

article.en: On the way, a young man waved to me.
article.zh: 途中，一个青年人向我招手。

article.en: I stopped and he asked me for a lift.
article.zh: 我把车停下，他向我提出要求搭车。

article.en: As soon as he had got into the car, I said good morning to him in French and he replied in the same language.
article.zh: 他一上车，我就用法语向他问早上好，他也同样用法语回答我。

article.en: Apart from a few words, I do not know any French at all.
article.zh: 除了个别几个单词外，我根本不会法语。

article.en: Neither of us spoke during the journey.
article.zh: 旅途中我们谁也没讲话。

article.en: I had nearly reached the town, when the young man suddenly said, very slowly, 'Do you speak English?'
article.zh: 就要到达那个城镇时，那个青年突然开了口，慢慢地说道：“你会讲英语吗？”

article.en: As I soon learnt, he was English himself!
article.zh: 我很快了解到，他自己就是个英国人！
